item.name: 00 - Authentication & Token

item.description:
Obtain Entra tokens for an **already registered** user.

Redirect URI: `https://developer.fsm.com/api/v1/auth/entra/callback` (same as FGS app registration â€” `redirectUri` in **FGS Globals**).

## Recommended â€” Manual browser flow
1. Select **FGS Globals (Local)** environment.
2. Set `entraUserEmail`, `entraClientSecret`.
3. Ensure gateway is running on `https://developer.fsm.com`.
4. Run **Manual browser flow â†’ 1. Copy sign-in URL to console** â†’ **Send**.
5. Open **View â†’ Show Postman Console**, copy URL into Chrome/Edge, sign in.
6. Browser redirects to the FGS callback. **Copy `code=` from the address bar** (ignore any error JSON on the page).
7. Paste into environment variable `authCode`.
8. Run **2. Exchange Authorization Code** â†’ `accessToken` is set automatically.
9. Use other FGS collections (FileService, SetupService, etc.).

## Token lifetime
Access tokens ~60 min. `offline_access` returns a **refresh token** â€” run **3. Refresh Access Token** to renew.

EC2: verify endpoint uses /user-service/api/v1/... prefix. Register redirectUri in Entra only after HTTPS is available.
item.name: Entra Token (Existing User)

request.description:
**Use Manual browser flow** (folder below).

The FGS redirect URI is `https://developer.fsm.com/api/v1/auth/entra/callback`. After Entra login the browser lands on that URL with `?code=...` in the address bar.

The FGS callback page may show an error JSON (it expects an invitation `state` for onboarding). That is OK â€” **copy the `code` from the URL** before the page loads or from the address bar, set `authCode`, then run **2. Exchange Authorization Code**.

Postman **Get New Access Token** (collection Authorization tab) does **not** auto-return when using the FGS callback URL â€” use the manual flow instead.

exec: console.log('=== Open this URL in Chrome/Edge ===');
console.log('=== After login, copy code= from the callback URL into authCode ===');

request.description:
Click **Send**, then open **View â†’ Show Postman Console**. Copy the printed URL into Chrome or Edge.

After sign-in you will be redirected to `{{redirectUri}}?code=...` â€” copy the code into `authCode`.
Exchanges `authCode` with Entra directly. `redirect_uri` must match the authorize step (`{{redirectUri}}`).
Confirms `accessToken` is accepted through the gateway (UserService JWT validation).

item.description:
FGS Backend-for-Frontend (orchestration only).

Company signup spans User (identity) + Setup (business types).

Gateway (Docker): https://developer.fsm.com
Swagger: https://developer.fsm.com/swagger/bff/
GraphQL: https://developer.fsm.com/api/v1/bff/graphql

Import with FGS Globals (Local). Prefer gatewayUrl = https://developer.fsm.com when using Docker Compose.

EC2 gateway paths use /bff-service/api/v1/... prefix.
item.name: BFF Service
00 - Company Signup (BFF orchestrated)
item.description: Run against Docker gateway. Request is AllowAnonymous. Each run generates a unique signupEmail so you can re-send safely.

request.description: Direct container health (port 5003). Requires a published port or use from inside the Docker network. Prefer request 2 against the gateway for end-to-end signup.

BFF orchestration:
1) FluentValidation on BFF
2) UserService creates tenant/company/user/invitation + invite outbox
3) SetupService seeds business types
4) Returns consolidated CompanySignupResultDto (includes tenantCode)

AllowAnonymous. businessTypeIds must contain at least one GloBusinessType id (typically 1 in local seed).
HotChocolate read-aggregation scaffold. Future composite reads land here.

item.name: SignupController
item.description: Generated-style mirror of the BFF signup controller.

request.description: Same endpoint as folder 00. Set signupEmail to a unique address before sending if not using the orchestrated folder.

info.description:
EC2 dev deployment at http://100.54.14.213.

Collection URLs use the EC2 gateway directly (not {{gatewayUrl}}). Service-prefixed nginx routes:
- /user-service/api/v1/...
- /setup-service/api/v1/...
- /bff-service/api/v1/...

Import **FGS Globals (EC2 Dev)** for secrets (accessToken, entraClientSecret, redirectUri, tenantId).

Run **00 - Authentication & Token** before protected APIs.
